row.team_price_text: Starter: from $249/mo billed yearly ($2,988/yr), 2,000 MAU, 3 seats
row.evidence: UserGuiding's pricing page lists 'SAML SSO & Team Member Activity Logs' only on Enterprise, and its SAML guide offers just-in-time account creation with no SCIM; IdP-deactivated users only lose access when their session expires and must be removed manually.
row.notes: No SCIM, set by absence across the pricing page, the full help-centre sitemap and the User API docs; the SAML guide describes JIT creation and manual removal only. SAML SSO is Enterprise only (the help centre still calls the tier 'Corporate'). Plans are flat per account by MAU: free Support Essentials (1 seat), Starter from $249/mo billed yearly (3 seats, 2,000 MAU), Growth from $499/mo (10 seats), Enterprise custom (unlimited seats); extra seats are add-ons. The User API manages end-users of the customer's product, not UserGuiding team members, so no team-management API is documented. Not found in Okta OIN (404) or as an Entra tutorial (404).

plans.name: Starter
plans.price_text: From $249/mo billed yearly ($2,988/year), up to 2,000 MAU

plans.name: Growth
plans.price_text: From $499/mo billed yearly ($5,988/year), up to 2,000 MAU

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Unlimited seats; team-member activity log in the UI (no API documented). Help centre calls this tier 'Corporate'.

limitations.text: Users deactivated in the IdP keep their UserGuiding membership; they lose access only after the 30-minute session timeout and must be removed manually from Settings > Team.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint or provisioning guide in the help-centre sitemap; SAML JIT creation is the only IdP-driven lifecycle.

user_api.notes: The documented User API covers end-users of the customer's product (create, update attributes, delete, list, reset history, track events), not UserGuiding team members.

fallbacks.notes: SAML JIT creates the team member on first login (seat required); otherwise admins invite members from Settings > Team.
